name: calsnap
description: CalSnap — AI calorie tracker PWA. Static site; this manifest exists only to run the test suite.

scripts.lint: node -e "const{readdirSync}=require('fs');const{execFileSync}=require('child_process');for(const d of ['assets/js']) for(const f of readdirSync(d)) if(f.endsWith('.js')) execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',d+'/'+f]); execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check','sw.js']); console.log('syntax OK')"
